name: Shanghai Karon Eco-Valve Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Based in Shanghai, China, Shanghai Karon Eco-Valve Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (established in 1991 and formerly known as Shanghai Karon Valves Machinery Co., Ltd. until its September 2020 name change) specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of a comprehensive range of valves, alongside related automatic control systems and environmental protection equipment. The company's diverse product line includes various types such as butterfly, check, gate, air, and hydraulic control valves. These solutions are vital for a broad spectrum of applications, from municipal infrastructure like water treatment, urban networks, and subways, to major industrial sectors including petrochemicals, steel, power generation, shipbuilding, papermaking, and biopharmaceuticals. While primarily serving the Chinese market, Shanghai Karon also exports its products globally to countries such as the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, Australia, South Africa, and Brazil.
